blocks.text: Surrey Lots & Vacant Land — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of lots and land are listed for sale in Surrey?

Surrey land listings include serviced single-family building lots, subdividable older residential properties, Neighbourhood Concept Plan (NCP) townhome or low-rise assembly parcels, industrial/commercial parcels, and rural/ALR acreage in
South Surrey
Cloverdale
, and

How do I check a Surrey lot's zoning, OCP designation, and utilities?

Use the City of Surrey COSMOS online mapping portal to view parcel zoning, Official Community Plan (OCP) and secondary plan land-use designations, water/sanitary/storm main locations, road dedications, and environmental or riparian development permit areas.
How do Bill 44 (SSMUH) and Bill 47 (TOA) affect Surrey residential lots?

Bill 44 requires municipalities to permit 3 to 6 housing units on qualifying single-family lots inside the Urban Containment Boundary, while Bill 47 designates higher-density Transit-Oriented Areas within 400m and 800m of SkyTrain stations and 200m and 400m of bus exchanges.
What are Development Cost Charges (DCCs) when building or subdividing in Surrey?

Development Cost Charges are per-lot or per-square-foot fees collected by the City of Surrey and Metro Vancouver at subdivision or building permit issuance to fund roads, water, sewer, drainage, and parkland infrastructure.
Does 5% GST apply to vacant land purchases in Surrey?

Yes, 5% GST frequently applies to vacant subdivided lots, commercial/development land, and lots sold by builders or corporate entities. Always include clear GST clauses in the Contract of Purchase and Sale and verify tax treatment with a CPA.
How does Surrey's Tree Protection Bylaw affect lot clearing and building?

Protected trees on private lots require a City of Surrey Tree Cutting Permit before removal, backed by an arborist report, tree retention plan, and replacement-tree planting or municipal Tree Fund deposits.
What financing is required to purchase a vacant lot in Surrey?

Lenders typically require a 25% to 35% down payment on serviced urban building lots and 35% to 50% down on raw or rural land, with construction draw mortgages releasing funds at foundation, lock-up, drywall, and completion stages.
